newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney bank business hurt by bad debt.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney bank business hurt by bad debt.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said Tuesday that results from its banking operations were hurt by bad debt trends and declined $7 million from last year's third quarter.

The company reported third quarter earnings today of $0.95 per share fully diluted, compared to $0.95 in the year-ago quarter. The current quarter included non-recurring expenses of $21 million net of tax, or $0.08 per share.
Total bad debt losses for the quarter increased 30 percent, or $0.05 per share, over the year-ago quarter, the company said.

The company said net interest expense and credit card costs increased $34 million in the period compared with the 1995 quarter and attributed the increase to continued higher bad debt losses. It also attributed the higher costs to increases in the reserve to cover future write-offs of customer receivables.
